intro: Unearth the truth about Stonehenge: dig with your shovel, blast through rock layers with dynamite, and grab all the gold!
description:
The truth about Stonehenge is buried far too deep… It’s time to dig it up! Grab your shovel, stock up on dynamite, and embark on a thrilling underground adventure. Blast through layers of rock, collect gold, upgrade your gear, and uncover the ultimate mystery. But tread carefully: deep beneath the earth sleeps something that should have never been awakened...

Game Features

    Addictive Gameplay: Dig, blast, gather gold, and head back to the surface for brand-new upgrades!

    Powerful Upgrades: Level up your shovel for faster excavation, boost your stamina for longer expeditions, and buy a jetpack to swiftly escape danger.

    Explosive Arsenal: Shatter the toughest rock layers with dynamite, carving out the quickest path into the depths.

    The Ultimate Underground Secret: Every gold vein brings you one step closer to the answer—why was Stonehenge really built?

    A Deadly Inhabitant: An ancient monster lurks in the abyss. Every detonation stirs it from its slumber… Will you uncover the truth before the beast catches up to you?
